children: may retest a resistance at $97.71 per barrel, a break above which could lead to a gain into $98.69-$99.30 range.
Even though the market failed three times to overcome this barrier, as long as it hovers above the support at $96.12, the uptrend will be considered intact.
A break below $96.12 will not only signal the reversal of the uptrend from $93.15, but also confirm a small double-top, which suggests a target of $94.53.
On the daily chart, the contract is testing the resistance at $97.95. A break could open the way toward $102.62. A wedge indicates a much higher target of $117.
The resistance is identified as the 61.8% projection level of a wave C. Generally, this projection level could be strong enough to hold, likely to trigger a correction.
A failure to break the resistance will be confirmed by a break below the support at $96.12 on the hourly chart.
